title: Event
description:
One event on the stream `events.subscribe` opens.

```json
{"schema_version": 1, "seq": 42, "time": "2026-11-25T12:00:00.000Z", "topic": "run", "type": "run.text", "data": {}}
```

schema_version.description: The schema version this document follows.

seq.description: Strictly increasing per home, from 1. `events.subscribe {since}` resumes after it.

time.description: When it happened: RFC 3339, in UTC, to the millisecond (`2026-11-25T12:00:00.000Z`).

topic.description: What it is about, such as `run` or `daemon`. A client ignores topics it does not know.

type.description:
What happened, named under its topic: `run.text`, `daemon.gap`,
`fleet.agent.spawned`. A client ignores types it does not know.
